description: This file implements the 'Edit' feature for articles in a C# ASP.NET Core application. It defines request models, validation logic, and the handler that performs article updates including managing tags, updating properties, and error handling.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Contains nested classes and records for the article editing feature, including data models, validation, and handler logic.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the command to edit an article, updating its properties and tags, handling errors if the article is not found.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to the article based on the input TagList.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which existing tags should be removed from the article based on the input TagList.
